description: This file defines Swagger API documentation models for WorkingDays-related endpoints in the Fineract project, specifically for the org.apache.fineract.organisation.workingdays.api package. It includes classes for request and response schemas used in working days API calls.

classes.name: WorkingDaysApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains inner static classes that define Swagger schema representations for WorkingDays API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetWorkingDaysResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response returned when fetching working days details.

classes.name: GetWorkingDaysTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response providing options for working days template.

classes.name: PutWorkingDaysRequest
classes.description: Schema model for the request payload to update working days.

classes.name: PutWorkingDaysResponse
classes.description: Schema model for the response after updating working days.
